purpose: Resolve the high-confidence lexical and decomposition issues left after the 2026-07-21 component-family repair.
selection_rule: Include only roots personally confirmed to have a misleading primary gloss, a misleading reusable component gloss, or a learner-hostile apparent decomposition.

頁.reason: Page is the ordinary standalone meaning; head remains the useful historical component image in descendants.

于.reason: At is the common lexical meaning and a legitimate reusable relation; Yu was an obscure surname/name reading forced into 31 cards.

丑.reason: Ugly is the high-value Simplified Chinese meaning; clown remains a vivid legitimate image only inside the root mnemonic.

其.reason: Their is a compact primary retrieval gloss; the apparent one-stroke split did not explain the graph.

开.reason: Open is the ordinary lexical and component meaning; initiate was an unnecessarily indirect synonym.

皮.reason: Skin is the ordinary lexical and pictographic image; covering was overgeneralized.

豕.reason: The graph is a pig pictograph; splitting it into one plus a pig alternate form was circular.

足.reason: Foot is the common lexical meaning and the graph is a foot-and-leg pictograph; lower leg was unnecessarily narrow.

骨.reason: Bone is the ordinary lexical and component meaning; skeleton incorrectly widened the graph.

攵.reason: 攵 is a hand-with-stick component form of 攴, not hair tuft plus mow grass.

豆.reason: The graph historically depicts a stemmed vessel, while beans is a phonetic-loan meaning; grass top was neither.

彡.reason: The graph depicts strands of hair and should not be reduced to a single slash.

共.reason: The graph depicts two hands holding a vessel; twentieth plus one was a learner-hostile apparent split.

壴.reason: The graph depicts a decorated upright drum; soldier, mouth, and grass top were misleading labels.

彑.reason: The graph is a head-on snout and should not be reduced to one horizontal stroke.

雚.reason: Grass top alone did not explain the stork/heron graph or its reusable family.

趼.reason: Callus restores the complete dictionary sense that had been truncated to the unusable phrase callous skin on.

鳽.reason: Heron is the learnable lexical target behind the dictionary note used in naming bitterns and herons.

趼.reason: The compatibility form inherits the corrected callus target from 趼.

鳽.reason: The compatibility form inherits the corrected heron target from 鳽.
